title: Invisible Circuit Breaker States
pattern: An inline circuit breaker modifying its routing state (Closed, Open, Half-Open) without raising metrics, state events, or logs.
why_bad: The application appears healthy to external observers, yet features are failing silently inside the system boundary, making diagnostics impossible without runtime debugger attachments [250].
detection: State mutations on routing gates that do not call telemetry loggers or counter increments.
fix: Hook circuit breaker state transitions directly into logging, metric, and operational dashboard subsystems.
